ESP32-C5 Workshop

A hands-on workshop covering ESP-IDF installation, project creation, component-based development, Wi-Fi connectivity, NVS data storage, Wi-Fi provisioning, and low-power (ULP) core programming.

Praktický workshop pokrývající instalaci ESP-IDF, tvorbu projektů, vývoj s komponentami, Wi-Fi konektivitu, NVS ukládání dat, Wi-Fi provisioning a programování low-power (ULP) jádra.

ESP32-C6 Workshop

A comprehensive workshop adding a dedicated Protocols/TLS chapter and covering seven assignments in total, including secure communication and ultra-low-power programming.

Komplexní workshop s kapitolou o protokolech/TLS a celkem sedmi úkoly, včetně bezpečné komunikace a ultra-nízkoenergetického programování.

About / O workshopech

These workshops are designed for developers who want to learn ESP32 development using the official ESP-IDF framework.

Estimated time: 180 minutes each
Hardware: ESP32-C5-DevKitC or ESP32-C6-DevKitC
Software: Visual Studio Code with ESP-IDF extension

If you have any feedback, feel free to open a discussion on GitHub.
